blocchi.nota: history of open interest by token starts 2026-09-03: percentiles are on the days available, fewer than 90, and days with fewer than 90% of the tokens are left out; the families add up to the 76 tokens of the total; funding and account ratio use the tokens of the family that have the reading that day; today's family members are applied to the whole history; Memecoins and AI and compute are the public CoinGecko categories 'Meme' and 'Artificial Intelligence (AI)', as downloaded on 9 Oct 2026; a token in more than one category goes to the category with the larger market value

frasi.testo: Leverage regime: Mixed since at least 1 Oct 2026; 2 of 6 gauges expanded over 30 days
Open interest in perpetual futures across 76 tokens rose 3.9% in 30 days, to $19.3B
Open interest was 0.80% of market value across 76 tokens, down from 0.81% 30 days earlier
2 of 76 tokens paid above the standard funding rate, against 5 30 days earlier
Implied volatility on Bitcoin options (DVOL) was 37.7, the 22nd percentile of the past year
Liquidations in perpetual futures were $5.68B in 30 days, down 12% from the 30 days before

dati.metodo: one set of 76 tokens for every value and sentence: tokens with open interest on Binance perpetuals, market value and funding both on the day and 30 days earlier; per family: open interest divided by the market value of the same tokens; funding and account ratio weighted by open interest; flat inside a band of 5% for the ratio
dati.cancello_nota: gate result for the sentences: ok = at least one sentence passed; each sentence carries its own result; the values in tables and history are not certified one by one
